headline: Voted 6-0 to enter executive session to discuss a recent cybersecurity incident affecting district information systems.
summary: The meeting covered a recent cybersecurity incident affecting district information systems. Members voted 6-0, with one member absent, to go into executive session on the district's security devices and response strategies.
decisions: Approved entering executive session under G.L. c. 30A, § 21(a)(4) to discuss security devices and strategies related to a recent cybersecurity incident, 6-0 with one member absent.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion passes to enter Executive Session pursuant to G.L. c. 30A, § 21(a)(4) to discuss the deployment of security devices and strategies with respect thereto in connection with the recently discovered cybersecurity incident affecting district information systems, because public discussion of the district's cybersecurity measures and response strategies could compromise their effectiveness.

MINUTES OF THE SCHOOL COMMITTEE  
EMERGENCY SPECIAL MEETING 
Wednesday, September 9, 2026 
 
LOCATION 
Springfield Public Schools 
1550 Main Street 2 FLR, New England Boardroom, Springfield, MA 
 
I. CALL TO ORDER – SPECIAL MEETING – ROLL CALL 
Chairman, Mayor Sarno called the Special Meeting to order at 5:43 PM. 
Roll Call Attendance: 
Ms. Valentin - Present 
Ms. Crawford - Absent 
Ms. Hurst - Present 
Mr. Gomez, Jr. - Present 
Ms. Gresham – Present 
Ms. Monroe Naylor (Vice Chair) - Present 
Mayor Sarno (Chair) - Present 
 
A. Invocation 
A moment of silence was held. 
B. Pledge of Allegiance 
The pledge of allegiance was led by Mayor Sarno. 
II. Vote to enter Executive Session pursuant to G.L. c. 30A, § 21(a)(4) to discuss the 
deployment of security devices and strategies with respect thereto in connection with the 
recently discovered cybersecurity incident affecting district information systems, because 
public discussion of the district's cybersecurity measures and response strategies could 
compromise their effectiveness. 
 
On a motion made by Ms. Monroe Naylor and seconded by Ms. Hurst, a roll-call vote was taken. 
It was noted that the School Committee will not reconvene into open session concluding the 
Executive Session. 
 
Roll Call Vote:  
Ms. Valentin - Yes 
Ms. Crawford - Absent

Motion passes to enter Executive Session pursuant to G.L. c. 30A, § 21(a)(4) to discuss the 
deployment of security devices and strategies with respect thereto in connection with the recently 
discovered cybersecurity incident affecting district information systems, because public 
discussion of the district's cybersecurity measures and response strategies could compromise their 
effectiveness. 
 
The School Committee ended the live broadcasting at 5:45 PM to commence the Executive 
Session. 
Respectfully Submitted, 
 
Triny Vargas 
Executive Assistant to the School Committee
